title: Vanilla Plus
description: A modpack for players who want better features but don't want to deviate too much from vanilla minecraft
body:
### Vanilla Plus Modpack

**Overview:**

Vanilla Plus is the perfect modpack for players who love the core experience of Minecraft but want a little extra polish and flair. It enhances the default vanilla feel while staying true to the basics of the game. With mods that improve the visual and gameplay experience, Vanilla Plus offers subtle yet impactful improvements, making your Minecraft world feel fresh without losing that iconic vanilla charm.

**Key Features:**

* **Better Hurt Cam**: A more immersive and responsive hurt animation system. When you take damage, the screen shakes more naturally and realistically, enhancing the feeling of danger in the game.

* **Better F3**: A revamped debug screen that provides clearer, more organized information, giving you more control and insight into your gameplay without cluttering your screen with unnecessary details.

* **Eating Animations**: Say goodbye to the static, awkward eating animations. This mod adds smooth, animated eating motions, making it feel much more realistic as you munch down on food.

* **3D Skin Layers**: Customize your character with enhanced 3D layers on your skin, giving you more detailed and dynamic customization options for your avatar.

* **Improved Sound & Visuals**: Enhancements to ambient sounds and subtle visual tweaks to make the world feel more immersive, from grass rustling to the sound of the wind.

* **Quality of Life Enhancements**: A range of mods that improve inventory management, streamline crafting, and allow for more efficient gameplay. All designed to feel natural, never intruding on the classic Minecraft experience.

**Why Vanilla Plus?**

Vanilla Plus is all about enhancing your Minecraft experience without radically changing the core gameplay. It’s perfect for players who love the simplicity of vanilla but want a few enhancements that make the game feel more modern and polished. Whether you're building, exploring, or fighting mobs, this modpack makes everything feel just a little bit better without straying too far from the game you know and love.

**Install Vanilla Plus and rediscover Minecraft.**
